output_text:
Modern enterprise dotfiles for macOS, Linux, and WSL; tiered shell, tmux, and Neovim. `bin/dot` is the modular CLI; tools are declared in `config/tools.yaml`. Profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`; template: `plugins/local/hello-world/`. Neovim: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`. Tmux: `config/tmux/tmux.conf`, `config/tmux/core.conf` (Ctrl-a, hjkl, |, -). Zsh: `config/zsh/`; modes fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms). Lazy loading, caching, resource-aware optimization, platform detection.

Commands:
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload

dot ai review
